Backend: 15/15 tests pass (7 new tts/did + 8 auth-flow). /api/did/config correctly returns configured:false (D-ID key denied by account), voice_provider:'elevenlabs', voice_id:'EXAVITQu4vr4xnSDxMaL'. /api/tts/config returns configured:true. /api/tts/speak returns 200 with audio/mpeg and ~non-empty blob. Empty text -> 400. Unauthed -> 401 on both. Auth 403 with 'Detectamos: <email>' AND canonical warning log now confirmed working. Unauthorized-access card shows with 'Cambiar de cuenta Google' button. CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG: voice-toggle-button never renders and /api/tts/speak is NEVER called after Elena replies -- Dashboard.jsx never calls ttsApi.config(), so ttsAvailable stays false, so the voice-toggle-button (which is gated behind {ttsAvailable && ...}) does not render, AND handleElenaReply early-returns before invoking ttsApi.speak(). This defeats the entire live-voice feature.

ui_bugs.issue: voice-toggle-button is never rendered because state `ttsAvailable` is never set to true. The `ttsApi.config()` call is missing from the Dashboard mount useEffect (only didApi.config() is called at lines 44-65 of /app/frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.jsx). Result: Bryan cannot mute/unmute Elena.

integration_issues.flow: Elena chat reply -> ElevenLabs voice playback
integration_issues.issue: After the chat stream finishes and ChatPanel calls onElenaReply(finalText), Dashboard.handleElenaReply short-circuits with `if (!ttsAvailable || !voiceEnabled) return;` because ttsAvailable is never set. Confirmed via network capture: 0 POSTs to /api/tts/speak were made after sending 'Hola Elena' and waiting 20s. Backend TTS endpoint itself works (verified: returns audio/mpeg 200 in isolation). Fix: add `ttsApi.config().then(({data}) => setTtsAvailable(!!data.configured)).catch(() => setTtsAvailable(false));` in the same useEffect that calls didApi.config().

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.jsx useEffect (around L44-65) add a call to ttsApi.config() to populate ttsAvailable state -- otherwise the voice-toggle-button never renders and /api/tts/speak is never invoked, defeating the whole ElevenLabs live-voice feature promised in the fix summary.
Consider surfacing a subtle console.warn (or a toast) when ttsApi.speak() rejects (e.g. autoplay-blocked or 5xx) instead of failing silently, so integration failures are noticed.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully green. The ONLY remaining bug is the missing ttsApi.config() call in Dashboard.jsx which prevents voice-toggle-button from rendering and prevents ElevenLabs playback after chat replies. A one-liner fix. After E1 patches, re-run the Playwright dashboard flow and confirm (a) [data-testid='voice-toggle-button'] present, (b) a POST to /api/tts/speak fires after sending a chat message, (c) button title toggles between 'Silenciar voz de Elena' and 'Activar voz de Elena'.
rca of the issue: handleElenaReply at Dashboard.jsx L105-136 gates all ElevenLabs playback on `ttsAvailable` state. That state is only ever initialized to false and never updated because ttsApi.config() is never called at mount. Similarly, the voice-toggle-button JSX at L201-221 is wrapped in `{ttsAvailable && ( ... )}`. Both symptoms have a single one-line root cause: add a ttsApi.config().then(({data}) => setTtsAvailable(!!data.configured)) call to the mount useEffect. No backend change required.
